source:
@@U02376@@
Tame your wings,
mind the accustomed reins!
Master yourselves as I master you.
When I urge you onward, surge away.
But now we must honor these halls!
Look around you,
see the admiring crowd
thronging forward,
circle round circle!
But come, Herald, do your duty.
Describe us in your fashion,
name us, before we take off.
Being allegories,
I suspect you should recognize us.

@@U02378@@
Name you?
I couldn't possibly.
I'd do better
describing you.

@@U02380@@
Then do so.

@@U02382@@
I must confess, first,
that you're young
and you're handsome.
A half-grown boy
that the ladies will happily
see fully grown one day.
You appear a future ladies’ man,
a born seducer.

@@U02384@@
Not bad!
But continue.
translation:
@@U02376@@
驯服你的翅膀，
注意习惯的缰绳！
掌握你自己，就像我掌握你一样。
当我催促你前进时，就冲走吧。
但现在我们必须尊重这些大厅！
看看你的周围，
看到欣赏的人群
蜂拥而至，
圈圈圈圈！
但是来吧，先驱报，履行你的职责。
用您的方式描述我们，
在我们起飞之前，请说出我们的名字。
成为寓言，
我想你应该认得我们。

@@U02378@@
说出你的名字？
我不可能。
我会做得更好
描述你。

@@U02380@@
然后就这样做。

@@U02382@@
首先我必须承认，
你还年轻
你很帅。
一个半大的男孩
女士们会很高兴
有一天看到完全长大。
你看起来是未来的女装男人，
天生的诱惑者。

@@U02384@@
还不错！
但继续。
